newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Hour Glass starts subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Hour Glass starts subsidiary.

text.p: Diversified Singapore watch retailer The Hour Glass Ltd said on Thursday it will start a subsidiary company, R.S. Hour Pte Ltd, to carry out the import and export of watches and jewellery.
Hour Glass said in a statement that the subsidiary will be 60 percent-owned by the company and have an issued capital of Singapore $500,000.
The remaining shares in the company will be held by Robert Sia Sok Hia, a senior sales executive of the company.
